name: Create Limit V 02
definition: Scope|The CreateLimit message is sent by a member to the transaction administrator.|It is used to create one or several limits set by the member and managed by the transaction administrator.|Usage|Based on the criteria defined in the CreateLimit message, the transaction administrator will execute or reject the requested creation and respond with a Receipt message as a reply to the request.

MessageHeader.name: Message Header
MessageHeader.definition: Common business identification for the message.

LimitData.name: Limit Data
LimitData.definition: Identifies one particular limit set by the member and managed by the transaction administrator.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
